cold_cage_candidate.status: preferred development challenger; not structural or site acceptance
cold_cage_candidate.three_node_scope: Ideal static force and first-moment equilibrium at existing conceptual grid axes only. The selected field excludes other actions and facets. Member stiffness and arm torsion/flexure, real nodes/piles, connections, uplift resistance and site capacity remain unqualified. Compression/contact or other actions can change the stipulated axial-only failure.

connector_sensitivity.scope: Continuous rods connect cold receiver to the underside of a trial cap plate; actual cold anchorage, plate connection, construction sequence and bar material remain unqualified. Fixed-fixed, equal split and nominal smooth gross sections are stress sensitivities only. Real fixity, embedment, shear, tension, fatigue, slip, ductility, reinforcement, DPC, gas, moisture, fire and thermal qualification are absent. The bars and bores are not selected.

decision: Inward 300 square and straight roof-to-pier-to-grid route are a source-bound candidate for joint STR/MAT/HAD challenge, not a selected design. The four-bar crossing is unqualified; direct full RC bypass remains a thermal/capillary adverse comparator. No actual ground/support capacity is asserted.

cap.scope: Wing overhang and 110 mm saddle are explicit steel bracket candidates, not anchored/capacity-qualified. Proposed 15 mm ceiling liner top6390 leaves20 below pier top; actual ceiling/fire/service layers require review.

hip.scope: Axis and section are explicit candidate; separate inner valley, hip tie, crown, steel node and external edge remain to design.

jack.first_x500_decision: Reject two independent seats; hip-rooted cantilever, eave contact omitted, requires moment connection.
jack.purlin_screen_scope: Trial full UDL, gross major axis and fixed-end geometry only; weld/cleat, torsion, actual loaded rows, second axis, restraints and deflection limits are not qualified.
jack.scope: Below AVCL/glass. Moment connection, member resistance, steel torsion, lateral restraints, penetrations and exact rail/purlin geometry unproved.

north_module_comparator.source: Parent ordinary_edge_development cover-and-wet-gutter; single module comparator only, not an SW action or extra roof load.

q450_interface.purlin_scope: At x500/q450 the cold post bears on the top-flush jack/purlin node, not directly on the eave ring. EW purlin approaches adjacent jack face x540; its below-AVCL steel may pass over the hip within the checked vertical envelope. Moment seat, post base, 50 mm channels, warm AVCL collars, weather, tolerance and actual full 3D section remain unqualified.

ring.scope: Conventional steel ring candidate substitutes a concrete eave collector at SW, remains inside nominal 140 core. End steel saddles, ring anchorage, casing, fire, local source changes and full member actions are not designed.

finite_roof_candidate.scope: One strip family and its mirror preserve vertical force and signed first moments in each assigned strip. The 0.02 m² tip, central eave rectangles, ridge/inner valley facets and cantilever-rail torque need their stated independent supports; they are not replaced by the old collapsed corner endpoint. No whole-corner endpoint, capacity or site acceptance is claimed.
finite_roof_candidate.status: one finite outer-SW triangular face and mirrored west counterpart, not complete corner/roof load path
